info.description: This is an API for DV Merchant
info.title: DV Merchant

post.description: Creates a refund request of a blocked transaction of the store. A refund to a sender of the deposit is scheduled without a code and sent after the cooldown (status scheduled). A refund to another address requires the code sent to the wallet email (send-code) and is sent after the store owner approves it (status pending_review)
post.summary: Create a refund of a blocked transaction

post.description: Returns the estimated network fee and the amount to receive for a refund of a blocked transaction of the store. code_required is true when the address is not a sender of the deposit: send a confirmation code to the wallet email (send-code) and pass it on the refund creation. The fee is an estimate and may change by the time of sending
post.summary: Estimate a refund of a blocked transaction

post.description: Sends a one-time code to the wallet email. The code confirms a refund of the blocked transaction to the destination address which is not a sender of the deposit, pass it on the refund creation. The code can be sent again once a minute

get.description: Returns a refund request of the store with its status
Get extended list of store currencies grouped by tokens and blockchains
get.summary: Get extended list of store currencies

get.description: Get exchange rates for all currencies enabled on the store (rate is scale-adjusted; original_rate is without store rate_scale)
get.summary: Get rates for all store currencies

post.description: Marks the given wallet address as dirty so it will not be used for new payments

risk_type.description: RiskType is the rule's risk_type: a signal category, TOTAL_RISK_SCORE, SUM_OF_SIGNALS or RISK_LEVEL

threshold.description: Threshold is the rule's threshold, for RISK_LEVEL it is the level rank (none=0 ... critical=4)

value.description: Value is the checked value which reached the threshold, for RISK_LEVEL it is the level rank

code.description: Code is the one-time code sent to the wallet email, required when the address is not a deposit sender

cost_per_erc20.description: Cost in Wei for single ERC20 transfer

cost_per_native.description: Cost in Wei for single native transfer

is_l2.description: Whether this is an L2 chain

l1_data_fee_estimate.description: Estimated L1 data fee for L2 chains
